title.rendered: Christmas DJs – San Francisco Bay Area

content.rendered:
We only have a few dates left over the December – Christmas period.

Please call Chris of California Disc Jockeys on 415-350-5474 for availability and a quote.

We service the entire San Francisco Bay Area with classy weddings, events and parties

Thank you for stopping by!

Chris 415-350-5474


California Disc Jockeys
Laguna Street
San Francisco
415-350-5474
